error_taxonomy.Auth_Hallucinations: Assumed standard OAuth2/Bearer for Basic/Custom auth (Close, WooCommerce, Copper)
error_taxonomy.Gating_and_Paywall_Oversights: Confused trial signup with API access (SE Ranking, Ahrefs, HighLevel, Gladly)
error_taxonomy.Architecture_CLI_Misclassification: Classified local scripts/packages as cloud REST APIs (Sherlock, Mermaid CLI)
error_taxonomy.Product_Entity_Conflation: Conflated consumer UI with enterprise API (NotebookLM, iPayX, Salesforce CC)

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 assumed standard OAuth2 Bearer token for modern CRM.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Close REST API securityScheme specifies HTTP Basic Auth where API key is passed as username with empty password.
pass2_verification_loop.corrected_auth: HTTP Basic Auth (API Key as username, blank password)

final_human_check.notes: Confirmed in Close settings. API keys generate instantly and pass as Basic Auth base64(apiKey:).

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 missed custom header requirements.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Copper requires three specific custom HTTP headers: X-PW-AccessToken, X-PW-UserEmail, and X-PW-Application.
pass2_verification_loop.corrected_auth: API Key + User Email Headers (X-PW-AccessToken, X-PW-UserEmail)

final_human_check.notes: Verified against developer.copper.com. Standard Bearer tokens are rejected.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 saw developer portal (api.docs.dealcloud.com) and assumed self-serve API keys.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: DealCloud uses OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow exchanging clientId and apiKey for a 15-minute Bearer token. No self-serve trial exists.

final_human_check.notes: DealCloud is owned by Intapp. Access requires enterprise subscription and User Group Capability enabling by admin.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 labeled auth as Bearer Token.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Freshdesk requires HTTP Basic Auth with API key as username and 'X' as password.

final_human_check.notes: Confirmed in Freshworks developer docs.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 assumed self-serve developer signup.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Pylon has no public self-serve signup. It requires a sales demo / B2B workspace onboarding.

final_human_check.notes: Tokens can only be generated by Workspace Admins on active B2B plans.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 assumed Gladly had a self-serve developer sandbox like Zendesk.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Gladly is an enterprise customer service platform with no public trial; sales contact is mandatory.

final_human_check.notes: Confirmed via developer.gladly.com and sales onboarding requirements.

pass1.error_details: Accurately captured BotFather token flow.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Confirmed: api.telegram.org/bot<token> works with zero friction.

final_human_check.notes: Verified. 100% self-serve and instantaneous.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 missed Meta Business Manager requirements and conversation pricing.

pass2_verification_loop.loop_triggered: Meta Developer Policy & Graph API Checker
pass2_verification_loop.finding: WhatsApp Cloud API uses Meta System User Access Tokens (OAuth 2.0). Sandbox is free, but production requires Meta Business Verification and phone number registration.
pass2_verification_loop.corrected_access: Semi-Gated (Sandbox Free; Production Requires Meta Business Verification)

final_human_check.notes: Verified against Meta Graph API docs. High friction for production agent deployment.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 saw Google Cloud OAuth and missed the mandatory Google Ads Developer Token.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Google Ads API requires BOTH OAuth 2.0 and a 'developer-token' header, which requires compliance review for production ad accounts.

final_human_check.notes: Confirmed. Basic access requires filling out an application and passing Google policy review.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 assumed anyone can generate an API key.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: GoHighLevel API v2 uses OAuth2 and requires an active Agency account ($97-$497/mo) or approved marketplace developer profile.

final_human_check.notes: Confirmed. Sub-accounts cannot generate API keys independently without agency admin.

pass1.error_details: Accurately identified Shopify Partner ecosystem and official MCP.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Confirmed: Official Shopify MCP server exists; unlimited development stores.

final_human_check.notes: Verified. Industry benchmark for developer experience.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 assumed OAuth 2.0 Bearer token.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: WooCommerce uses HTTP Basic Auth with Consumer Key (ck_...) and Consumer Secret (cs_...).

final_human_check.notes: Confirmed via WooCommerce REST API documentation.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 conflated Salesforce CRM Free Dev Org with B2C Commerce Cloud.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: B2C Commerce Cloud (Demandware) is distinct from core CRM. It requires Account Manager credentials gated behind enterprise contracts.

final_human_check.notes: Confirmed. You cannot test B2C Commerce SCAPI using a free Developer Edition Salesforce org.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 completely missed AWS IAM SigV4 and seller vetting.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: SP-API requires Login with Amazon (LWA) OAuth2 + AWS IAM credentials + AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) calculation. Account requires paid Professional Seller ($39.99/mo) and Data Protection Policy review.
pass2_verification_loop.corrected_auth: AWS SigV4 + LWA OAuth2 + AWS IAM
pass2_verification_loop.corrected_access: Gated (Professional Seller Account + Strict Compliance Review)

final_human_check.notes: The most complex API in the research set. High barrier to entry for any independent developer.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 scraped fanbasis.com home page and missed the rebrand to Commas and creator approval.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Developer docs moved to commasdocs.com / dev-docs.fanbasis.com. Creator onboarding and approval required to access dashboard secrets.

final_human_check.notes: Verified. npm packages published under @fanbasis scope; checkout session secrets require creator account.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 saw 14-day free trial on homepage.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: SE Ranking API is explicitly excluded from trial and entry tiers; requires Pro or Business subscription.

final_human_check.notes: Confirmed on seranking.com/api.html pricing terms.

pass1.error_details: Accurately captured Bearer auth and official MCP server.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Confirmed: Instant key creation; official Firecrawl MCP works flawlessly.

final_human_check.notes: Verified. Benchmark tool for LLM web extraction.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 classified Sherlock as a SaaS REST API.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Sherlock is an open-source Python CLI tool with NO hosted REST endpoint. It runs locally or in Docker.

final_human_check.notes: Confirmed via github.com/sherlock-project/sherlock. Needs containerized MCP wrapper.

pass1.error_details: 100% accurate.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Official GitHub MCP server verified; fine-grained PATs supported.

final_human_check.notes: Verified.

pass1.error_details: Accurately captured internal integration secrets and official MCP.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Confirmed: Requires Notion-Version header; official Notion MCP server available.

final_human_check.notes: Verified.

pass1.error_details: 100% accurate on test mode and OpenAPI spec.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Confirmed: Instant test keys; official Stripe MCP available.

final_human_check.notes: Verified. Gold standard developer API.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 confused iPayX with a traditional merchant card gateway requiring underwriting.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: ipayx.ai is an AI & MCP-native FX audit engine with a public MCP endpoint at https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp.

final_human_check.notes: Critical disambiguation! iPayX is natively designed for AI clients.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 assumed standard SaaS self-serve API.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: PitchBook Direct Data API is an enterprise-only add-on with high annual minimum spend ($25k+).
pass2_verification_loop.corrected_access: Gated (Enterprise Sales Gate / High Contract Value)

final_human_check.notes: Confirmed. No self-serve trial or public signup exists.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 conflated Gemini API with NotebookLM.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Consumer NotebookLM (notebooklm.google.com) has NO public REST API. Enterprise access is Gemini Notebook Enterprise via Google Cloud Discovery Engine with IAM roles.

final_human_check.notes: Verified. Crucial product distinction between consumer web app and enterprise Cloud API.

pass1.error_details: Pass 1 assumed cloud REST API service.

pass2_verification_loop.finding: Mermaid CLI is an open-source Node.js package (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli). No cloud API exists; runs locally as mmdc.

final_human_check.notes: Verified. Best implemented as a local containerized tool.
